Hi Alice —

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we're all aligned: 

What we covered
- Acme's priorities: data residency in us-east-1, HIPAA-scope for PHI in a subset of workflows, and strict network isolation for production workloads.
- Redwood options: Hosted API for quick start, Dedicated for reserved capacity, and Private (VPC / on-prem) for strict isolation and compliance.
- SOC 2: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type II for our hosted and dedicated control plane; Private deployments leverage the customer's environment plus our audit artifacts.

Immediate next steps
1) I'm attaching a short SOC 2 summary and our Private/VPC options doc (links below). Please share any specific compliance controls you need to see for HIPAA scoping.
2) We'll initiate the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) — I'll send a Drive link and a filled starter sheet for your team to review.
3) I'll draft a network diagram showing typical Private VPC (managed control plane + customer-hosted inference nodes) and an air-gapped variant for on-prem.
4) Can you confirm target timeline for pilot (target start date) and whether Acme has an internal procurement VSQ template you'd prefer we fill?

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, private_vpc_options.pdf

Thanks — I'll follow up with the VSQ link and a draft diagram by EOD tomorrow.

Best,

Hi Alice — thanks for the fast reply and for sending the VSQ.

Air-gapped option
- Short answer: yes, we support an air-gapped on-prem deployment. Typical pattern: customer-provisioned inference nodes in an air-gapped network, with a one-time secure bootstrap of model artifacts and an offline control plane (or a minimal control plane in a locked VPC). This increases setup time and operational overhead but satisfies strict isolation requirements.
- Ops & cost: expect higher engineering setup (initial delivery 4-8 weeks depending on site), and increased run-rate due to manual patching and limited autoscaling. We can provide a firm estimate after we review network constraints and hardware choices.

Next actions from Redwood
1) I've uploaded a draft network diagram showing (A) Private VPC with managed control plane + customer nodes and (B) air-gapped on-prem flow: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/ACME-VSQ-20270115
2) We'll start filling Acme's VSQ and post the starter answers to the same Drive folder by EOD tomorrow.
3) Can you confirm whether Acme has a procurement deadline or any DocuSign / procurement contact we should loop in?

I'm attaching a quick network diagram draft for your review.

Attachment: network_diagram_draft.png
